idea-plugin.name: Maekom API Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom API Runner — Spring Boot API Scenario Runner & PSI Auto-Sampler for IntelliJ IDEA.
  • 🌶️ Gutter chili icon on Spring Web controller endpoints (@GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, @PatchMapping, @RequestMapping)
  • Auto-generates URLs, query strings, path variables, and pretty-printed JSON request bodies from DTOs & Java records
  • Multi-step scenario chaining with Jayway JsonPath extraction, Fail-Fast policy, and local secret separation (.maekom/secrets.local.json)
  • 3-pane bottom ToolWindow with instant cancellation and non-JSON response safety
